climate: A dry climate, and what little rain there is falls mostly in summer. Water is scarce.
Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A west Texas AVA of about 270,000 acres in Jeff Davis County, surrounded by the Chihuahuan Desert and using cooler elevations. It was the last AVA recognized in the 20th century and began with one winery on about 40 acres.
